name: Gift of Nature
body:
Prerequisites: Briarborn, Grow Armor

Benefit: You may enhance your grown armor as though it were enchanted. You may add a +1 enhancement bonus (enhancement or ability) to the armor per four levels.

Dwellers in Dream: The Briarborn. Copyright, January 27, 2013, Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian “Necroblivion” Berg, Richard “AWizardInDallas” Hunt
